entry.title: Resolution 462 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): — → Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES AND DIRECTS THE DIRECTOR OF FINANCE TO NEGOTIATE THE DISPOSITION OF REAL PROPERTY IDENTIFIED AS TAX MAP KEY NO. 7-4-010:044 BY LEASE TO HOPE SERVICES HAWAIʻI, INC., FOR HOMELESS ASSISTANCE PURPOSES

Authorizes the negotiation of a one-year lease with one one-year option to renew with an approximate annual cost of $10. The property, located at 74-5593 Pawai Place, would continue to be used as an assessment center and emergency shelter for individuals who are experiencing homelessness.

Status: — → Adopted

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 462-26 & FC-128 - 03/04/26
